source: Inch Calculator, Cabinet Door Calculator, Find the Dimensions of the Panel
conversion: 1 in = 25.4 mm; source output 14.125 in converts to 358.775 mm and rounds to the engine's 0.1 mm precision.
tolerance: Exact to 0.1 mm, matching engine output precision.
scope: Validates only panel width from the published example: door width minus two stiles plus two groove depths minus 1/16 in expansion space at each groove. Does not verify panel height, seasonal-movement recommendations, or other joinery assumptions.
